status_semantics.DONE: current provider-view behavior already satisfies the target eligibility rule
status_semantics.PARTIAL: mitigation exists but automatic provider visibility or lifecycle leakage remains
status_semantics.OPEN: current behavior conflicts with the target eligibility rule or lacks the required gate
status_semantics.KEEP: surface is intentionally eligible under the stated narrow condition

target_classes.ALWAYS_INLINE: must remain in provider context by contract
target_classes.ACTIVE_EPHEMERAL: eligible only while the current unresolved run/turn needs it; consumed immediately afterwards
target_classes.ACTIVE_STATE: canonical current effective state only; historical versions are retrievable
target_classes.REF_ON_DEMAND: default no body; hydrate only when current task dependency is proven
target_classes.OBSERVABILITY_ONLY: event/state/tool/UI surface; zero prompt by default
target_classes.PROTOCOL_ONLY: retain only the minimum bytes required by provider protocol
target_classes.CONDITIONAL_EXTERNAL: external message becomes eligible only when it is an actual current task/control dependency

entries.current_behavior: R6 freezes canonical current human text and makes it the exact semantic tail of the initial human-ingress provider envelope.
entries.target_rule: Never retire, summarize, rewrite or duplicate the current human text.

entries.current_behavior: assistant(tool_calls) and matching tool results stay in the active protocol chain.
entries.target_rule: Keep while the current run requires protocol/result consumption; after a resolved final answer, retire the old tool chain from default future-turn projection.

entries.current_behavior: R8.5 indexes newly proven non-empty/non-truncated completed model-answer episodes into a durable EpisodeStore, stamps stable resolved_episode_ref only after fsync succeeds, and removes those messages from future provider working context. Pre-R8.5/legacy turns without explicit resolution proof remain visible fail-open and are not guessed resolved.
entries.target_rule: Once answered/resolved, default future prompt visibility is zero. Explicit follow-up/continuation may hydrate required fragments from an episode index.
entries.retrieval_path: search_records(kind=episode, query="") -> stable episode ref; query=<keyword> searches; query=<episode:... ref> hydrates exact visible user/assistant/tool transcript with bounded paging

entries.current_behavior: For R8.5-proven resolved episodes, assistant tool-call declarations and tool results are durably indexed before the episode is retired from later provider view. The current unresolved turn keeps full protocol pairing. Legacy turns without resolution proof remain visible.
entries.target_rule: After the consuming final answer resolves the episode, archive/index the tool chain and remove it from default next-task provider view.
entries.retrieval_path: EpisodeStore stable ref via search_records(kind=episode); exact visible tool chain is hydrated on demand

entries.current_behavior: Existing REASONING_TAIL policy remains. R8.5 additionally retires the entire proven resolved episode from future provider view and deliberately does not duplicate private reasoning_content into EpisodeStore hydration. Legacy/unresolved cloud tool-call reasoning still follows provider protocol policy.
entries.target_rule: Retain only reasoning bytes still required by the active provider protocol/pairing. Resolved historical reasoning is archive-only.
entries.retrieval_path: Visible resolved transcript is episode-hydratable; private reasoning is intentionally not duplicated as retrieval content

entries.current_behavior: R8.5 adds a conservative standing-instruction guard: explicit cross-turn user rules (e.g. 以后/始终/永远/不要再/from now on/always use/never use) keep the exact user message provider-visible even when the surrounding episode retires. A canonical effective-state store with supersession is still not implemented.
entries.target_rule: Keep only the currently effective constraint/value in active state. Superseded source turns remain retrievable but invisible by default.
entries.retrieval_path: Exact standing user text stays active; resolved surrounding episode remains available by episode ref; broader decisions remain memory/history retrievable

entries.current_behavior: R3 still governs current-turn automatic memory eligibility. R8.5 now marks memory_snapshot messages inside a proven resolved episode with the episode ref, removes them from flat future provider history, and also skips resolved refs in Cognitive _packet_parts so the packet side-channel cannot resurrect them. Legacy/unresolved snapshots remain governed by existing R3 behavior.
entries.target_rule: Eligible only for the current active task dependency. Resolved turn snapshots become retrievable-only. Recency/K is not eligibility.
entries.retrieval_path: search_records(kind=memory) / exact memory ref; resolved visible episode transcript via episode ref

entries.current_behavior: R3 pointer/seen controls remain for current tasks. Experience-tip messages that belong to a proven resolved episode are now retired with that episode instead of persisting into later working context. Current/legacy eligibility is still not a full required-now gate.
entries.target_rule: Only task-relevant current experience may surface; resolved experience context returns to the experience index.
entries.retrieval_path: search_records(kind=experience) / experience ref; resolved episode transcript via episode ref

entries.current_behavior: R3 bounded catalog behavior remains for active/current turns. A session_digest_catalog persisted inside a newly proven resolved episode is retired with that episode, but catalog auto-surfacing for current tasks still exists.
entries.target_rule: Catalog stays outside prompt by default; current task asks for a specific historical dependency before a ref is surfaced.
entries.retrieval_path: search_archive / digest archive ref; resolved episode ref when catalog belonged to a retired episode

entries.current_behavior: R3 correctly stopped old key-fact/body replay, but compression/fold status frames and search_archive pointers can still be injected as prompt-visible context.
entries.target_rule: Once active task state is independently preserved, archive/fold occurrence is observability; historical content is retrieved by tool only.

entries.current_behavior: R5 keeps raw archive but strips identity/self-description details from derived long-term summary/index projection.
entries.target_rule: Keep existing R5 behavior.

entries.current_behavior: R4 new recovery is a closed one-shot runtime slot bound to the current human turn; legacy persisted recovery is filtered from provider view.
entries.target_rule: Keep one-shot semantics; never make recovery durable executable conversation history.
entries.retrieval_path: program.recovery audit event for history, not prompt

entries.current_behavior: model_switch_notice still duplicates recent user/assistant text during the active run and remains architecturally wrong as runtime observability. R8.5 prevents a notice inside a proven completed episode from leaking into later turns by retiring the whole episode. Current-run duplication is still OPEN work.
entries.target_rule: Model routing change is runtime state. Zero prompt by default. If an active task must be resumed, hydrate canonical active-task state rather than chat text.
entries.retrieval_path: model routing/status event; episode ref prevents stale next-turn replay but does not replace canonical active-task state

entries.current_behavior: declaration_reminder is still persisted before the final assistant and cannot repair that already-generated answer. For new proven resolved episodes, R8.5 marks and retires it with the episode so it no longer leaks to the next turn. Legacy reminders and the wrong write location remain to be cleaned up.
entries.target_rule: Audit/UI or pre-delivery correction only; never persist as next-turn prompt material.
entries.retrieval_path: declaration_check audit record; resolved episode ref for surrounding visible transcript

entries.current_behavior: Injected into session when repeated tool calls hit the reminder threshold; no generic run-end consumed retirement is applied.
entries.target_rule: If model guidance is still needed, visible only inside the unresolved run. Program-side breaker/telemetry owns persistence.

entries.current_behavior: Injected after repeated empty searches and persisted in session; path_registry already records negative evidence programmatically.
entries.target_rule: Prefer program-side negative-evidence handling. If visible to model, consume at run end and never leak to next independent task.

entries.current_behavior: First overflow appends a system feedback message for another attempt but the message is ordinary session history and has no generic consumed lifecycle marker.
entries.target_rule: Same-run control only; audit/runtime state after consumption.

entries.current_behavior: A run-end consumed mechanism exists, but it checks the legacy raw prefix after R1 has wrapped the message in PROGRAM_APPENDIX_NOTICE. Mechanical reproduction shows the consumed predicate and _is_injected_system are both false.
entries.target_rule: One current-run decision only; consumed by metadata identity rather than visible string prefix.

entries.current_behavior: Messages marked injected_system (and compatible legacy system prefixes) are removed from provider history when skip_injected_system=true.
entries.target_rule: Keep out of prompt; expose through architecture_status/event/UI.

entries.current_behavior: Cache monitor emits a dynamic GATE_NOTE into _inject_parts. The text itself says the model need not handle it.
entries.target_rule: Cache/control-plane event only; zero provider prompt chars.

entries.current_behavior: R2 may insert a budget receipt into the prompt after dropping blocks.
entries.target_rule: Budget accounting is program observability. If omitted content is required, retrieval/control logic should act; the model does not need assembler bookkeeping by default.

entries.current_behavior: With EVIDENCE_MODE=enforce, every build can append a recent evidence index directly as role=user before _inject_parts; this bypasses R2. The manifest itself tells the model to use evidence search/read tools.
entries.target_rule: Evidence ledger remains tool-addressable. Do not inject the manifest/index by default; hydrate only a proven current dependency.

entries.current_behavior: If an active Goal has tasks, build can render the frontier into every prompt. The tool task_frontier already exists for explicit inspection.
entries.target_rule: Only the current executable node/constraint required for model decision is eligible. Full graph/blocked/unreachable/completed state is tool-only by default.

entries.current_behavior: Hotcard is automatically consumed when it is unconsumed and originates from another session; cross-session is treated as sufficient to surface a handoff ref.
entries.target_rule: Cross-session is not continuation. Hydrate only when user explicitly continues/restores or a canonical active-goal binding proves continuation.

entries.current_behavior: First-seen topic=notify is still injected; backlog count can also become prompt text. Duplicate notify is later suppressed/archived.
entries.target_rule: notify/job-complete/backlog are event/UI state; zero prompt unless the current active task is explicitly waiting on that result.

entries.current_behavior: coordinate/task pending items are injected as program context when consumed from inbox.
entries.target_rule: Eligible only if the external message actually creates/changes the current active task. Otherwise keep in interop state and let the user/model inspect on demand.

entries.current_behavior: Fallback notices are appended as ordinary system messages without a generic consumed marker. A successful fallback response may already exist before the notice is appended.
entries.target_rule: Routing status is runtime/event state. If the model truly needs it during the unresolved run, make it one-shot ephemeral; never carry it into a later task.

entries.current_behavior: Every local-provider build appends a command-shaped tail behavior hint, including program-default file-count/autonomy rules and search guidance.
entries.target_rule: Remove from dynamic prompt. If any rule is truly authoritative, place it once in stable system/rules; evaluation patches do not gain production prompt authority.

entries.current_behavior: R8 profile recommendation is emitted as injection.profile.shadow event and applied=false; capability-only tests prove messages+tools byte identity.
entries.target_rule: Keep telemetry outside prompt until a separately approved behavior policy consumes it after eligibility.

entries.current_behavior: Legacy cache hit-rate lines in assistant content are stripped in build provider view; authoritative cache data is transported separately.
entries.target_rule: Keep telemetry out of conversational prompt.

entries.current_behavior: R8.7 applies a stable CORE9 plus current task/protocol/recovery-needed tool projection to local and cloud providers. Hidden healthy tools remain registered and discoverable through get_tool_schema catalog/search/exact lookup. Playwright is runtime-quarantined when unavailable; MCP tools/list=0 yields no live capability. Clean-source simple surface is 9 tools / 3,425 raw lazy chars (3,714 provider-wrapper chars) versus 61 / 22,699 all-lazy raw chars.
entries.target_rule: Expose a stable universal core plus task/state-relevant tools only; discover secondary schemas on demand. DEGRADED/QUARANTINED tools require runtime-health and failure-class recovery policy before visibility.

entries.current_behavior: A detected event-log/session gap produces a one-process-only tail tip telling the model to read event logs; it is not persisted to sess.messages but is prompt-visible once.
entries.target_rule: Prefer program-side repair/index reconciliation. If model participation remains necessary, keep it one-shot current-turn only and bind to a retrieval ref.

entries.current_behavior: Auxiliary component failures generate model-facing feedback in some paths even though selfheal_log/action telemetry is also persisted.
entries.target_rule: Program faults are tool/runtime state unless the current user task cannot proceed without an explicit model decision. Never persist stale fault prose into later tasks.

entries.current_behavior: Unknown program slots are semantically downgraded to STATUS and can continue into prompt aggregation/budget.
entries.target_rule: Unknown prompt producer is not eligible by default. Only an explicit prompt-producer allowlist may enter eligibility/profile/budget.

runtime_storage_snapshot.scope_note: read-only counts from session storage; not equivalent to current provider-wire counts
